reviews.text:
Caroline is amazing.  Deeply knowledgeable and caring, with the perfect touch to help our family understand the best way to raise an amazing puppy.  We worked with her in 2006 with our first pup, and are doing so again in 2026 with a new pup.  Caroline is always up to date with best practices, has a vast reservoir of tips and tricks, and underlays it all with the most important fundamental philosophy about positive training.

Our first puppy went on to be the the best dog we've ever had, and our new guy seems transformed after spending some time with Caroline.  Really, it's that we got to spend some time with her and she helped us understand what the pup needs, and has been asking for.

11/10.  Caroline is the best.  Worth every penny, and then some.

Caroline was amazing to work with! She helped me with my 2-year-old dog, who would constantly jump up to greet people. I honestly thought she would never stop jumping. I had tried other trainers before, but nothing seemed to work.

Caroline's approach was exactly what we needed. She took the time to understand my dog and gave me practical, easy-to-follow techniques that produced real results. Thanks to her guidance and consistency, my dog is so much calmer and no rarely jumps up to greet people.

I highly recommend Caroline to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, patient, and effective dog trainer. Thank you, Caroline, for making such a positive difference for both me and my dog!

My only regret is waiting until Connie was 12 weeks old to call Caroline.

I own a pet store, I've worked with dogs for decades, and I know pretty much everyone in the Toronto dog world. When I got my golden retriever puppy, I thought training classes would be enough for me. I was wrong. And honestly, I think sometimes knowing a lot about something makes it harder, not easier, to make good decisions. So I needed on-on-one help.

I hired Caroline based purely on her reputation with puppies. Never met her before. Within 10 minutes of our first in-home session, I felt like a completely different person. She gave me a clear plan, and suddenly everything felt manageable.

The support between sessions is something else. Caroline is so generous with her time, and there were a couple of moments where she genuinely talked me off a ledge. She has a way of being warm and completely no-nonsense/direct at the same time, and her instructions are easy to follow, which matters more than people realize.

She is practical, down to earth, and clearly has a profound understanding of dogs. I send a lot of people to a lot of places in this city, and I'm so grateful to have firsthand experience when referring her.

When we started looking for a trainer for our Golden Retriever puppy, Caroline’s name kept coming up - everyone said she’s the best. Now I see why.

Watching her work almost feels like magic. The small things she taught us - timing, tone, the right words - made an immediate difference. Things we struggled with started clicking right away (I truly think Caroline speaks dog language!! 😊).

Even after a short time, we’ve seen real change and feel so much more confident as dog owners.

Caroline is a true expert with years of experience, and it shows. So grateful for all the tools, insights, and support. Thank you so much!
Highly recommend to any dog parents! ❤️

Carolyn was a great help in teaching me how to train my wonderful 6-7 month old rescue puppy , Addie from the streets of Tijuana.  My pup responded very well to Caroline's patient , encouraging  manner of teaching .  The hardest part was for me was to understand her approach which after a few sessions , and helpful discussions I was able to see her way of teaching me how to understand my dog which was so important .  Carolyn made herself available through phone , and email and promptly answered all my questions and provided very useful videos and written out lessons for me .   Your dog is in good hands with Carolyn. She is very devoted to her work and  deserves recognition for the effort she puts into every training session

Big thank you from myself and Addie

We’ve had a really challenging journey with our dog, especially with reactivity in our condo building (elevators, hallways, other dogs—it was stressful for everyone). Working with Caroline has been a complete game changer.

What sets her apart is that she didn’t just train our dog—she trained me. She helped me understand how my own behaviour, energy, and reactions were influencing my dog, and showed me how to shift those so I could actually shape his behaviour in a calm, consistent way.

She took the time to understand our specific situation and gave us practical strategies we could use in real life—not just in a training session. She was also incredibly supportive and stayed connected between sessions, which made a huge difference when we were working through challenges.

Because of her, we’ve seen real progress, and I feel much more confident handling situations that used to feel overwhelming.

If you’re dealing with a reactive dog or want someone who truly understands behaviour and teaches you how to lead your dog, I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend her.

Caroline achieved the impossible… I never thought that my two-year-old dog would be comfortable in a crate as he hadn’t been crate-trained (and I’d been told by a previous trainer that he wasn’t meant for the crate!) but thanks to her extreme patience, expertise, and positive approach, he now goes in willingly and stays calm and comfortable. Thank you Caroline for helping me to achieve something that I’d never thought was achievable!!
Next stop… my second dog’s reactivity… can’t wait for that journey!

Sandy is an almost 11 year old dog who has always had anxiety, allergy and gut issues.  Some of her issues have improved significantly since we moved here from Vancouver a year and a half ago. However, after taking her to a groomer soon after our move, she developed stress colitis and became increasingly reactive and aggressive towards us in attempts of grooming and even being picked up. After the vet checked her to rule out physical issues, she referred us to Caroline.  After 3 sessions with her, we have seen some significant changes in Sandy’s behavior.  While we have a way to go, Caroline helped us understand cues Sandy was giving us. We are developing a much healthier relationship with our furry little girl when it comes to grooming and general cooperation.  Sandy seems happier and we are happier too.
Caroline is a very good communicator and clearly loves the work she does.  She is very conscientious and provided us with a wealth of information.  While we had a trainer early in Sandy’s life, we did not get the same kind of help as Caroline provided.  I will not hesitate to ask for her help in the future and , furthermore, would confident to recommend her to others.
Many thanks Caroline.

We picked up our puppy Harry when he was 10 weeks old. It’s been years since we’ve had a puppy in our lives and we realized pretty quickly that we were beyond rusty in how to raise/train a puppy.
So we reached out to Caroline at Raising Rover, through a word of mouth referral. Loved her website and her approach seemed to be a compatible one to our way of thinking.
We’ve just completed the 8 week puppy training course and it’s been fantastic!! It’s truly a human owner training course as well,  and we recommend Caroline 1000%. She is calm and gentle and endlessly supportive!! And even more so with our puppy! She is, at the same time, incredibly attuned to what puppies are feeling and needing. We call her our puppy’s lawyer!! She’s taught us a ton, with seemingly endless patience on her part + a healthy dose of humour and we’re grateful to have come into her orbit. Our puppy Harry is seriously in love with Caroline and we’re officially members of her fan club! We look forward to working more with Raising Rover, as our puppy (and we) mature.

I can’t recommend enough. My dog instantly fell in love with Caroline. She was kind and took the time to really learn my dog’s different anxieties and quirks. She taught me how to read my dog’s body language to better identify her triggers to better support her. This has helped manage her reactivity.

She constantly went above and beyond for my pup and you could feel and appreciate the genuine care she had. My dog definitely misses her sessions with Caroline.

Simply put, Caroline is incredible. She has changed our lives for the best! Caroline helped us unlocked a capacity to learn in our dog that we had not known was there, and we are truly better pup parents because of Raising Rover. If you are even considering hiring a dog trainer, do not hesitate to book with Raising Rover!

My husband and I got both of our Yorkies at different times during COVID-19, which really stunted their socialization. Our first pup, Josie, is quite independent and generally well behaved. We quickly established a wonderful routine with Josie and felt we were able to take her everywhere with us without issue. She adapted easily, listened to us, and fell into our schedule without hesitation. Josie made pet parenting so easy that we decided to get a second pup, Gordie. Training was much harder with Gordie. Admittedly, we were lax and didn't provide the opportunities that Gordie needed to succeed. Our failure to enforce basic training early on in Gordie's life, combined with his super playful, energetic nature caused reinforced communication issues. Gordie barked at everything and everyone, could not follow basic commands, and really struggled behaviorally on walks. After many failed attempts to follow training videos on YouTube and advice from friends, we were feeling discouraged and overwhelmed. We knew we needed to seek help.

After moving to Toronto, we reached out to Caroline in June 2025. From our initial consultation, we were blown away by her interest in our situation, compassion, and willingness to help. By July, we had enrolled in her program. Her pricing is beyond fair and she strives to make herself available for her clients. We were especially pleased that she was willing to come to us for training. Prior to our first lesson, we were worried that Gordie may not respond to training, but already felt confident that we would learn something from Caroline. She quickly identified the clear communication issue between us and Gordie, amongst other factors contributing to our mutual frustration. Caroline left us with manageable homework and several exercises. Between lessons, Caroline was super communicative, checking in on our progress and providing resources for success. With each lesson, we learned several things about ourselves and our dog. Caroline was even accommodating to our multi-dog household, catering her teaching to our situation.

After training all summer, we have now completed Caroline's program. Though our progress was not always linear, it was always positive. We learned more than we could have ever imagined from Caroline, both about how we can better interact with our dog and to better respond to how he expresses himself to us. Our friends and family say that Gordie is a completely different dog - he's still just as playful, energetic, and affectionate as ever, but he is able to control his emotions and better communicate with us. We feel that we have unlocked a capacity to learn in Gordie that we previously had not known was there, and we are truly better pup parents because of Raising Rover.

Thank you Caroline, you are the best!

We had the best experience with Caroline! This is the first dog for both myself and my husband and we had no idea where to begin with training. Caroline walked us through the basics with ease and then modified her lessons based on what we wanted to accomplish with training. She is so skilled with puppies and helped us gain comfort quickly. Tootsie finished training a month ago and continues to progress and learn thanks to Caroline’s lessons. Highly recommend!

Caroline worked with us in training our puppy, and we continued on with additional training because our experience with her was excellent. We saw our puppy grow in confidence and learn new skills through a positive and nurturing training experience. He loves to see her, as do so many dogs we encounter on our outdoor walks that have benefitted from her training as well. She reads extensively, and updates her approach and understanding as research evolves, and her advice can be confidently relied upon. Her ability to read dogs’ body language is helpful in the training process. Highly recommend!

I cannot recommend Caroline highly enough! She has been absolutely amazing for our puppy, Charlie, who started training with her when he was just 3 months old. From our very first session, it was clear that she genuinely cares about the well-being and development of every dog she works with.

Her approach to training is not only effective but also incredibly insightful. She helped us understand the essential skills Charlie needed to learn during his formative months and guided us through the process with patience and expertise. Each session was filled with practical tips and techniques that made training enjoyable for both us and Charlie.

Thanks to her guidance, Charlie has become a well-behaved and happy puppy, and we feel much more confident as pet owners. We are so grateful for her dedication and support!

We are looking forward to our next course with her - Teen Terrific.

We adopted our dog Welly about a year and half ago from a pug rescue. He is the sweetest dog, but unfortunately had some trust issues and would occasionally lash out and bite. Caroline was referred to us from our veterinarian and we are very happy to have met with her. She is a great teacher and showed us how to have a better relationship with Welly and also understanding dog behavior. As a result of working with Caroline, Welly has become much more calmer and we no longer worry about his aggressive tendencies since we now understand why they happened and how to avoid them. Also, Caroline taught us some really fun learning games which really helped build more trust with Welly overall. We definitely recommend Caroline to help you build a better relationship with your dog.

Thanks again Caroline, we appreciate your help.

Caroline is a very special trainer. She had incredible insight into the personality of my puppy, and was able to tailor our training sessions to suit our puppy. She helped me build confidence in reinforcing our lessons. She is very knowledgeable and had wonderful follow up for each lesson, with great notes and resources. Our puppy loves Caroline!

We cannot recommend Caroline enough. We got in touch with Caroline when we brought home our first puppy and were overwhelmed. She helped us gain confidence in ourselves as dog parents and created a real bond with our puppy. He wouldn’t be where he is today without her hard work and dedication.

We worked with Raising Rover with our spirited Labrador Retriever puppy. Caroline is exceptional! We and our pup learned so much! Gentle, positive, consistent practices learned over a series of private sessions (she came to us! 👍👍). The online tools are a great way to reinforce the learning.

Flash forward more than a year… we have a happy and well behaved Lab!  She’s still full of energy, but she responds immediately to all commands (come, touch, leave it…. Everything!), even when she’s fully engaged in fun stuff, she stops and does what’s been asked of her. We get many compliments on how well trained she is… and it’s all thanks to Caroline at Raising Rover.

She’s the best!!!!

We reached out to Caroline for training after bringing home our rescue pup. He was 5 months old when he came to us. With no name and no training at all under his belt, it was a big transition for him to be finally adopted and housed. Caroline patiently and kindly walked our family and him through all of the basics and more. She has been a tremendous resource and support. We learned a ton and our dog has accomplished so much. He has become a happy and stable guy and we cannot recommend Caroline enough.

We reached out to Caroline shortly after rescuing our 4 month old puppy, Harvey. From the moment we brought Harvey home, he was extremely fearful and cautious of basically everything. We couldn’t even get him off our front lawn without him barking at everything in sight. Dogs were by far his biggest trigger.

We were desperate and contemplating returning Harvey to the rescue and came across Raising Rover through some online research. We reached out to Caroline as a last ditch effort and she was incredibly quick in her response and was able to accommodate us as clients.

Within the 8 week program, we have seen tremendous growth in Harvey, more than we ever could have imagined possible. Entering the program we were just hoping to get Harvey to be dog neutral but now he has become a confident, happy, playful pup!

Caroline has a unique talent in recognizing a pups needs and crafting a training program that is truly tailored to them. Not only is she training the dog, but she’s training you as well! She gave us the tools to help Harvey overcome his fear reactivity by teaching us to view walks as training opportunities and how to properly use positive reinforcement to our advantage.

In this short time span, Harvey has made tremendous progress on leash, rarely reacting to dogs! He loves going to the off leash park and playing with other dogs! We can even sit outside of our local cafes, enjoying coffees and pup cups together!

If you told me this is where we would be 9 weeks ago, I would not have believed it. I truly believe the success we got in this short time period was due to the genuine connection and care that Caroline builds with us and the pups.

Caroline not only helped us train our puppy, but she also helped us fall deeper in love with Harvey and strengthen our bond.  He truly is our special boy and I can’t believe we ever thought about giving him up!

I would highly recommend Caroline! Thanks again for all you did to help us and Harvey!!

My dog's veterinarian highly recommended Caroline. Although I have worked with a few other trainers in the past, none of them had the depth of knowledge that Caroline has and I really appreciated her positive, rewards-based approach. My dog loved Caroline too! The practical in home demonstrations, feedback, and homework really helped me become adept at learning new skills. As a result of working with Caroline, I better understand my dog, my dog's behaviour has improved, and I feel we have a much closer bond.  Thank you, Caroline! You really are the best!
Caroline is the best Toronto based trainer in my humble opinion. I’ve put 2 Dogs (GSD’s) through puppy classes @ Raising Rover and wouldn’t hesitate with the next pup.   👍🏻👍🏻 …

My golden doodle Dillon had become reactive to other dogs, anxious and barking at random times in her 3rd year.  Help was needed and fortunately for us, we found Caroline and the Terrific Teen sessions.  Caroline focused on Dillon from the first minute of the first session – no time was wasted.  Dillon and Caroline bonded immediately, enhancing the training sessions.  As Dillon is very smart, the bulk of the training sessions were about me and my reactions, teaching me what I needed to do to assist Dillon to become the best version of herself – calm and happy.  No problem was insurmountable.  The email reminders were great at reinforcing the weekly lessons.
Thanks Caroline
Dillon and Tammie

Caroline is simply amazing. I contacted her to assist with training my new, 8 week old, Rottweiler puppy. As always when working with her she was quick to respond and to arrange a program for my puppy. …

Me and my pup Eddie can't recommend Caroline and Raising Rover enough. We had a private lesson for leash reactivity, after having done group reactivity lessons with another company and a couple private lessons with other trainers. All of …

Caroline was recommended to us by a friend and signing up with Raising Rover has been the best thing we’ve done for our pup and ourselves. There aren’t enough words to express our gratitude to Caroline for not only helping our pup progress …
